comparison.objective: Crack a walnut in a hand nutcracker and sort kernel from shell.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually compress sprung handles with force, then manipulate and sort small fragments.
comparison.success_condition: Both jaws apply at least 40 N for 0.1 seconds, kernel enters the bowl, all shell enters the saucer, and arms retreat.
comparison.reason: Forceful fracture and fragment sorting do not test parameter adjustment, fastener locking, or repeatable axial stopping.
